purpose: Dataset preparation only, no model fitting
scope: 30 fixed Census 2011 Odisha districts, matching the existing Kharif master. Not annual historical districts.
issue_date: October 31; assumed seven-day observation delay, not verified operational vintage
composite_rule: Start >=June 1; exclusive end <=October 25; full eight-day composites only
product: Combined Terra+Aqua MCD15A2H Collection 6.1, native sinusoidal grid
catalogue_revision_policy: For duplicate tile/date items use latest production timestamp in product ID; archive all catalogue versions. Reprocessed archive, not historical issue-date vintage.
mask: APRA500 Y-2, nearest neighbour; rice=1, non-rice=0, nodata=3; annual paddy proxy, not Kharif-specific
quality: raw LAI<=100; bit0=0; bit2=0; bits5-7<=1; bits3-4=0
composite_admission: At least 50% of all mapped paddy pixels across all intersecting tiles pass strict QC
monthly_features: Mean of admitted composite means, grouped by exclusive-end minus one day month. Missing stays blank; no interpolation.
diagnostics_not_predictors: Coverage, rice pixel counts and admitted counts are audit fields, not automatically model X
join: one-to-one Census 2011 district code + agricultural start year; retain all 570 base rows
geography_caveat: Fixed reference geometry, not independent annual boundary certification
evaluation_note: Existing outcomes have been examined before; any later comparison is retrospective. Current annual model is unchanged.

execution_revisions.reason: Handle duplicate catalogue production versions deterministically before extracting LAI or joining labels; latest production timestamp, all metadata retained.
